answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to post a slashable stake, then let a rotating beacon of randomly-sampled peers grade its real output. Honest contribution stays cheap to sustain, but minting a thousand sybils is not, because each clone must separately fund and risk its own stake. Over epochs an atlas of cross-attestations builds up like shale: thin layers of independent peer judgment compressed into a reputation that no single forged identity can counterfeit alone.
